title: Verify, request the exact human action, then resume
when: A declared site is signed out or an exploratory mission hits auth
need: Verify first; authorize opens only expired sites. Human supplies personal credentials; unreachable probes need technical repair. Sign-in pauses automated browsers on that machine until windows close. Disconnected test hosts receive nonsecret declarations; live identity store survives reset.
surface: Browser identities reference and authorize help; Pack per-OS sign-in procedure.
gap: Verified pointer defect: Pack browser-identities names docs/public/reference/... which external projects do not receive there. Use the installed .yoke/docs home. Per-OS links to Yoke-private test-account policy also need a portable audience boundary.
recipes: yoke projects capability-settings get --project P --cap-type browser-control --json
